description: VL-D0 §16 — interface only, nothing implements this yet. Shape a future 'what does Claude currently know' provider must fill so the Command Center UI (claude-command-shell.js) can render context without embedding any context-gathering logic itself. No component in this repository constructs this object; it is a target shape for VL-D1+.

fields.repository: identity/command_center.py repository_context() payload — branch, head, working tree state.
fields.active_view: Which shell workspace destination is focused (a sidebar-nav destination id), so a command like 'explain this' has a subject.
fields.selection: Optional: an id (segment/preview/profile/etc.) the operator has selected in the workspace, or null.
fields.recent_commands: Bounded list of the operator's last N submitted command-shell inputs, most recent first — for context, not for auto-replay.
fields.permissions: Which CommandRisk tiers the current session may run without an extra confirmation step. Never includes DESTRUCTIVE or GATED by default.

explicit_non_goals: This is not a memory store or conversation history — Claude Code's own session context handles that.
This never includes recording audio, embeddings, or any biometric artifact path — those stay behind the dataset access gate regardless of what Claude is asked.
No network transmission of any field here is implied or planned; local-first applies to this contract like everything else.
